runs.how: git archive d8ed782e | tar -x -C <temp>; copy new tests/test_terminal_api.py in; run

runs.command: uv run --no-project --python E:/software/miniforge/python.exe --with-requirements minimal-requirements.txt --with pytest --with pytest-timeout -- python -m pytest tests/test_terminal_api.py -o addopts= -q -p no:cacheprovider

not_rerun: real ConPTY/ASGI chain (kept as-is, not retracted; skipped inside the d8 archive because node_modules is gitignored)
shared core / launcher / IPC / emulator suites

fixes.1_shutdown_report: runtime.shutdown consumes the real service report via _classify_shutdown; confirmed only when Mapping has empty-list unconfirmed AND secrets_retained is exactly False AND budget_exhausted is exactly False AND no in-flight request / unfinished reconcile; otherwise unconfirmed with static problems + counts + public terminal ids only
fixes.2_slot_types: request slots tracked by token in _SlotLedger; _retire_request releases exactly once for slot-holding tasks; _retire_lifecycle never touches request slots; all results/exceptions consumed
fixes.3_closing_gate: call() re-checks readiness in the same no-await region as slot admission; after closing it raises GateRejected; _execute maps GateRejected to its 503 (not 500)
fixes.4_normalization: urlsplit ValueError (malformed URL/authority) caught -> None / config fail-closed; origin must have no path (trailing slash rejected)
fixes.5_rows_bounds: REST rows 1..500 / cols 1..1000, unified with the accepted service gate
fixes.6_streaming_body: read_json_object accumulates via request.stream() and rejects immediately past 64 KiB; bad UTF-8 / bad JSON / RecursionError -> static 422
fixes.7_lifespan_finally: server yield + stop_runtime go through terminal_lifespan (try/finally); exception/cancel still requests cleanup

verified_gates: clean report -> confirmed (positive control); non-empty unconfirmed -> unconfirmed with ids; secrets_retained True / budget_exhausted missing / malformed / non-Mapping -> unconfirmed; clean report + in-flight request -> unconfirmed
4 in-flight requests: shutdown completion keeps inflight==4; repeated _retire_request decrements once
after closing: call rejected (503 closing) with zero service calls; gate-passed + body-paused + closed -> 503, zero business execution
malformed origin http://[broken and trailing-slash origin -> 403 (not 500); legal origin -> 200; malformed allowlist config -> fail-closed
concurrent/timeout shutdown reuses a single in-flight task; late result consumed; finished-but-unproven retries the same service idempotently
rows 500 ok / 501 rejected / 1000 rejected; cols 1000 ok / 1001 rejected
body 64KiB+1 rejected without draining; deep nesting -> invalid-json; bad UTF-8 -> invalid-json; non-object -> invalid-body
terminal_lifespan runs stop on body exception and on normal exit
